[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira pricing model:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Free: Up to 10 users, limited features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Standard: $7/user/month (billed annually), includes project planning and workflows.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Enterprise: Custom pricing for large teams.
